integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a medium two-shot at eye level on an alpine rescue station deck, where Rostova stands beside Tomas Lind overlooking cloud-filled valleys. On the timber-framed decking beneath corrugated metal eaves, antenna arrays and weather station sensors flank panoramic views of cloud-filled valleys. An empty yellow Rescue Toboggan rests on deck snow. Rostova, with an athletic compact build, olive skin, dark brown crown braid, and focused hazel eyes, wears a red and yellow rescue parka, black thermal trousers, a white climbing helmet with headlamp, glacier goggles around her neck, and an Emergency Radio on her shoulder. Beside her, stocky Tomas Lind, with weathered ruddy skin and grizzled grey hair, wears an orange blizzard jacket, charcoal storm pants, a grey beanie, and a black climbing harness. They review coordinates. The narrator says: <d>[English] The cloud ceiling is dropping fast across the northern valley.</d> Rostova taps her clipboard against the railing. Rostova (S1) adds: <d>[English] We need to deploy before sunset.</d> After this line the voice-over stays silent for the rest of the shot. Tomas checks his watch as the camera slowly pans toward the precipice.

overall_soundscape: High-altitude mountain wind howls across the deck and rustles against the corrugated metal eaves. A sharp plastic click echoes as the clipboard taps the railing, followed by the faint mechanical hum of spinning weather sensors.
